newsitem.title: UK: Adscene's finance director leaves company.
newsitem.headline: Adscene's finance director leaves company.

text.p: Adscene Group said on Tuesday its finance director Nigel Chevin-Hall had stepped down and added it may sell off its commercial printing division after being approached by a third party.
Adscene, which hopes to find a successor for Chevin-Hall soon, declined to say why the finance director has left the company.
Adscene also said its publishing results were showing "meaningful" increases in the period since September when the second quarter started.
Trading in both publishing and printing had reflected market conditions in the first three months of the financial year from June 1.
"Printing has continued with this trend, whereas publishing, since September, has achieved meaningful increases over the previous year," Adscene said.
